coverage_object_indexes.description: Optional distinct zero-based positions from THIS request coverage_objects directory. They identify exact ContentNode/Requirement objects, not evidence indexes or assigned scopes. Select only objects whose coverage you actually account for; program does not infer whole-snapshot coverage.

coverage_state.description: Required with non-empty coverage_object_indexes: actual accounting status for all selected objects. assessed is not satisfied; partial/unassessed stays unfinished. Non-applicability needs actual grounds and cannot cancel a commissioned Requirement. Otherwise omit or use null.

coverage_reason.description: Required non-blank grounds and limits with coverage_object_indexes/state. Otherwise omit. Coverage is not inferred from successful reading or saving.
